model.description: Caller-selected Model ID, Endpoint ID, or Agent Plan model name. No automatic model substitution.

image.description: Reference image URL/data URL, or a list of reference images for editing and image-to-image generation.

size.description: Output image dimensions in pixels, e.g. 2048x2048, or a model-supported resolution preset such as 2K. K denotes a resolution class, not kilobytes; allowed sizes depend on the model.

seed.description: Dimensionless random seed (integer), not a count or duration; allowed values and sentinel values depend on the model.

description: Supply a nonblank prompt for generation/editing, or layer_decomposition=true and image for layer decomposition. stream=true is not supported.
